title: Conditions
subtitle: Show or hide fields and pages based on answers

ai.title: Describe your conditions
ai.placeholder: e.g. Hide the GST field unless Country is India

empty.title: No conditions yet
empty.description: Create rules like "if the answer is Yes, show the details field" to make your form dynamic.

showFieldOnChoice.title: Show a field when a choice is selected
showFieldOnChoice.description: Reveal a follow-up question only for people who pick a particular option.

hideFieldOnChoice.title: Hide a field when a choice is selected
hideFieldOnChoice.description: Remove a question that doesn't apply based on an earlier answer.

requireWhenFilled.title: Require a field when another is filled
requireWhenFilled.description: Make a follow-up mandatory once the respondent has answered the first question.

skipPageOnAnswer.title: Skip a page based on an answer
skipPageOnAnswer.description: Jump respondents past a section that isn't relevant to them.

chip.missingFieldHint: This field was deleted. The rule will not match until you fix it.
chip.missingPageHint: This page was deleted. The rule will not match until you fix it.

health.title: Logic health
health.subtitle: Problems that would surprise a respondent.
health.allClearBody: Every rule points at fields and pages that still exist.
health.noRulesBody: Add a rule to make this form respond to what people answer.
health.staleOption: "{{value}}" is no longer an option on {{field}}
health.circularDetail: {{count}} rules form a loop; fields caught in it stay visible.
health.unreachableDetail: {{field}} is hidden by default, and no working rule ever shows it.

simulator.title: Try it
simulator.subtitle: Set answers to see what a respondent would get.
simulator.noTriggers: No rule triggers on a field yet.
simulator.everythingVisible: Every field and page is visible.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this condition?
deleteDialog.message: This rule will be removed for everyone editing this form.

card.brokenReferenceHint: This rule references a deleted field, a deleted page, or an option that no longer exists. It will not match until fixed.
card.circularHint: These rules can contradict each other; fields caught in the loop stay visible.
card.backwardReferenceHint: This rule's action targets an earlier page than the answer it depends on, so the earlier page's visibility relies on something the respondent hasn't filled in yet.

editor.combinatorAny: Any condition must match — click to require all
editor.combinatorAll: All conditions must match — click to require any
editor.previewEmpty: Pick a field and an action to see the rule in plain English.

errors.selectField: Choose a field for this condition.
errors.selectOperator: Choose how to compare this field.
errors.enterValue: Enter a value to compare against.
errors.enterNumber: Enter a number to compare against.
errors.selectPage: Choose a page for this action.
errors.selectTarget: Choose at least one field for this action.

fieldFilter.label: Field: {{field}}
fieldFilter.emptyDescription: No condition rule matches the current search and filters.
